name: Soul Sword
text:
One of the Lost Relics of Tamriel. Once the royal sword of Price A'tor, It was enchanted with his own soul in an attempt to resurrect the prince after his assassination. Later used by Cyrus the Restless during his rebellion against the imperials. Consitered an occurence of HoonDing, it was given to Iszara, Queen-Regant of Hammerfell at the time.
Whatever enchantment it once had seems to have faded, perhaps Prince A'tor's spirit has passed on.

text:
One of the Lost Relics of Tamriel. This relic of Hercine was last seen in the hands of the Neverine after events of the Bloodmoon Prophecy. Which heralded the arrival of Hercine and his wild hunt on the Island of Solstheim in the later years of the 3rd Era.

It is said to be one of Hercine's favored hunting spears.
